pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal geometries with smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Mid-flank patches exhibit larger surface area and elongated orientations compared to the smaller, more circular fragmented patches on the posterior limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative space forms a continuous lattice of light pelage. Junction nodes are primarily tripartite. Pathways maintain a relatively consistent pixel thickness across the visible flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated contour along the dorsal ridge, indicating a short, dense mane silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-density cluster of micro-patches on the lower posterior region, contrasting sharply with the macro-patch morphology of the upper flank.
